The sari is an unstitched drape with many regional styles, while sarong names tubular or wrapped lower garments across regions; neither is adequately described as a long skirt. Record cloth dimensions, drape direction, underlayers, fastening, regional name and occasion before making a limited comparison with Hanfu panels and ties.
